_note: The Documents library, arranged in groups. Each group has a title and a list of items; each item needs a title and a url. desc is a one-line explanation, updated is the date of the document itself (not the day you added it) and can be left out. Add "portal": true when a homeowner has to sign in to the Portal to open it. Section rules are not listed here: they come from sections.json.
